description: This file contains the implementation of an Orleans grain for a bank account, demonstrating event sourcing with deposit and withdrawal transactions, as well as a variant that only persists the latest state.

classes.name: AccountGrain
classes.description: A journaled Orleans grain that models a bank account with event sourcing, supporting deposit and withdrawal operations.

classes.name: AccountGrain.GrainState
classes.description: Represents the current balance state of the account, with methods to apply deposit and withdrawal transactions.

classes.name: AccountGrain_PersistStateOnly
classes.description: A variant of AccountGrain that only persists the latest state, not the event log.

methods.name: Balance
methods.description: Returns the current balance of the account.

methods.name: Deposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount into the account and records the transaction.

methods.name: Withdraw
methods.description: Attempts to withdraw a specified amount from the account, returning false if insufficient funds.

methods.name: GetTransactionLog
methods.description: Retrieves the list of confirmed transactions (the transaction log).
